title: Rescue Plan
next_chapter_hook: While Chen Ji was still savoring the warmth of that kiss, Ye Qing in the distant Holy Sect received a shocking transmission—her spy planted in the Heavenly Fate Lock Chamber had disappeared.

text.content:
The night wind howled, causing Chen Ji's robes to flutter violently. He stood frozen, as if struck by lightning, his pupils contracting sharply. That name—the name he thought he would never hear from another's lips again—was now clearly spoken by Ye Qing.

Chen Nian.

His sister, the girl forever frozen in his memory at the age of eight.

dialogue.content: "Chen Nian was taken by the Holy Sect twelve years ago." Ye Qing's voice was cold, yet carried a hint of imperceptible sympathy. "She is imprisoned in the deepest part of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds—the Heavenly Fate Lock Chamber."

text.content:
Twelve years.

Chen Ji's fingers trembled slightly, his knuckles turning white from clenching. During these twelve years, he had countless times awakened in the dead of night, dreaming of his sister's desperate eyes, yet never dared to hope he could see her again.

And now, Ye Qing told him—his sister was still alive.

dialogue.content: "Why are you telling me this?" Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, yet he suppressed the inner turmoil. "What do you want?"

Ye Qing turned around, moonlight illuminating her refined features, a complex light flickering in her eyes.

"Because you need this intelligence, and I have it." Her voice was calm. "More importantly—our goals align. The Holy Sect is our common enemy."

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly closed his eyes. When he opened them again, the excitement had been replaced by cold calculation.

Fine.

Since Ye Qing was willing to provide intelligence, he would hear this Demonic Path Holy Maiden's sincerity.

dialogue.content: "Tell me the specifics." Chen Ji's tone had already returned to its usual composure. "Where exactly is the chamber? How many guards? What's Chen Nian's condition?"

"The Heavenly Fate Lock Chamber is located at the core of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, surrounded by nine layers of formations." Ye Qing began detailing. "Normally, there are thirty-six Yuan Ying stage guards, rotating shifts, changing every three days."

"In three days, the Tianmo Ridge Forbidden Grounds will open. The Holy Sect will dispatch most of their elite to explore the grounds—at that time, the chamber's guards will be reduced to the minimum: no more than ten." Ye Qing's voice lowered. "That's the best opportunity."

text.content:
Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly as he quickly calculated the pros and cons. In three days, it would be when he participated in the Three Sects Tournament. If the chamber's guards would be at their lowest then, he would need to create chaos during the tournament to draw the Holy Sect's attention.

"Anything else?" he asked.

dialogue.content: "Yes." Ye Qing's expression grew solemn. "Chen Nian is being used as the 'Heavenly Fate Lock'—her bloodline has some kind of resonance with the Tianji Record. If you use the Tianji Record to foresee her location, the images will be blurry and unclear."

text.content:
Chen Ji's eyes flickered with a sharp coldness. He had tried before to foresee matters related to Chen Nian, and indeed always felt there was a layer of mist shrouding everything. It wasn't a problem with the Tianji Record, but with Chen Nian herself.

"Heavenly Fate Lock..." he murmured. "What does that mean?"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji faces a critical decision: to steadily gather more intelligence, or seize this rare opportunity to act immediately?

choices.description: First arrange for Ye Qing to investigate the Holy Sect's internals, ensuring intelligence accuracy before taking action. Better to wait a few more days than to act carelessly.
choices.visible_cost: Time delayed, sister suffers three more days
choices.visible_reward: More accurate intelligence, increased success rate for action

dialogue.content: "Fine." Ye Qing slightly nodded. "I will use my Holy Maiden identity to conduct deep investigations, and provide you with detailed intelligence in three days."

text.content: Chen Ji nodded, already calculating in his heart. During these three days, he would create enough chaos at the Three Sects Tournament to pave the way for the subsequent action.

choices.description: The opportunity in three days will be fleeting—immediately begin deploying the rescue plan. Within Chen Ji's character, the courage to burn the bridges never lacks.
choices.visible_cost: Intelligence may have omissions, higher risk
choices.visible_reward: Save time, sister suffers less for three days
choices.risk_hint: May fall into an unknown trap

dialogue.content: "Bold spirit." A flash of appreciation flickered in Ye Qing's eyes. "Since it's so, I'll begin setting up the arrangement now. In three days, there will be someone to receive me inside the Holy Sect."

text.content: Chen Ji turned, cold light glinting in his eyes. Twelve years of waiting, it was time to end it. Sister, wait for me.

choices.text: Two lines proceeding in parallel, employing multiple strategies simultaneously
choices.description: Let Ye Qing investigate first while he participates in the Three Sects Tournament to create chaos, proceeding on both fronts simultaneously. Risks and rewards coexist.
choices.visible_cost: Need to handle variables on both lines simultaneously
choices.visible_reward: Maximize time utilization, balancing information and timing
choices.risk_hint: May win the battle but lose the war

dialogue.content: "Interesting." Ye Qing chuckled lightly. "You participate in the tournament, I'll infiltrate the Holy Sect. Let's see who exposes their weakness first in these three days."

text.content: The two exchanged a glance, a strange tacit understanding filling the air. Chen Ji knew this woman was no ordinary person, but at this moment, she was the only one who could help him.

The night wind grew chillier, but Chen Ji's eyes grew brighter. He began constructing the entire plan's framework in his mind, leaving no detail unchecked. "The guards' shift change times, the formation's weaknesses, the interior structure of the secret chamber..." he said slowly, "How confident are you?"

dialogue.content: "Seventy percent." Ye Qing replied candidly, "But with your Tianji Record foresight, it should rise to ninety percent." Her gaze fell on Chen Ji. "The前提是，你能承受预知的代价。"

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment. Heavenly Fate Value was his most precious resource at present. Every foresight consumed five points, and as the Tianji Record became more complete, the consumption would only grow larger. But that was Chen Nian. His only relative.

dialogue.content: "I understand." Chen Ji's voice was low but firm. "I'll use the Tianji Record to confirm the secret chamber's exact location and guard distribution. But regarding Chen Nian's personal situation—" he paused, "I'll have to rely on you to gather intelligence within the Holy Sect."

"No problem." Ye Qing nodded. "I have people inside the Holy Sect who can approach the Heavenly Fate Lock Chamber." She paused, adding, "But you must be prepared—Chen Nian's condition may not be good. Twelve years... enough to change many things."

text.content: Chen Ji's fists unconsciously tightened. Twelve years, he couldn't imagine what his sister had endured. But no matter what, he would rescue her. "Tell me the specific infiltration route." His voice regained its composure.

dialogue.content: "When the Ancient Demonic Ridge Forbidden Grounds open, the Holy Sect will open a secret passage to transport supplies." Ye Qing took out a Jade Slip, projecting a map into the air. "This passage leads directly to the rear of the Holy Sect, bypassing the outer formations."

"You enter from the forbidden grounds, I'll arrange for someone to receive you inside." Ye Qing pointed to a marker on the map. "This is the entrance to the secret chamber, the weakest link among the nine-tiered formations. If everything goes smoothly, we can reach the core area within half an hour."

text.content: Chen Ji studied the map carefully, his brow sometimes furrowing, sometimes relaxing. This plan was interconnected like links in a chain, but there were too many variables. Any single mistake could lead to total failure. "Can the receiving person be trusted?" he asked.

choice.prompt: Regarding the receiving contact inside the Holy Sect, Chen Ji needed to further confirm their reliability.

choices.description: Directly ask Ye Qing for specific details about the receiver, including identity, motivations, and trustworthiness.
choices.visible_cost: May appear to not trust Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more detailed intelligence to reduce risks

dialogue.content: 'They are my people.' Ye Qing's brow furrowed slightly, but she wasn't angry. 'You don't need to know too much. Just remember—they, like me, all want the Holy Sect to fall.'

text.content: Chen Ji looked at her expression and knew he couldn't extract more information. But at least one thing was certain—Ye Qing wouldn't lie to him at this critical moment.

choices.description: Since the decision to cooperate has been made, extend Ye Qing full trust. Don't get bogged down in details; show magnanimity.
choices.visible_cost: May increase risk due to insufficient intelligence
choices.visible_reward: Enhance cooperative relationship and improve coordination synergy
choices.risk_hint: Extremely dangerous if the contact betrays

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's gaze softened slightly. 'You're quite straightforward.' She murmured quietly, 'Don't worry, I don't joke about such things.'

text.content: Chen Ji nodded, redirecting his attention to the plan. He knew that in such a life-or-death operation, trust was the cornerstone of cooperation.

The plan gradually took shape. Chen Ji took a deep breath and began mentally simulating every possible contingency.

In three days, the Heavenly Demon Ridge Forbidden Land would open. He needed to create chaos during the Three Sects Tournament, drawing the Holy Sect's attention. Meanwhile, Ye Qing would open a passage from within to directly infiltrate the Heavenly Fate Lock Key chamber.

dialogue.content: 'What about after rescuing Chen Nian?' Chen Ji asked, 'The Holy Sect won't let this go. How do we escape?'

'During the Forbidden Land's opening, space becomes unstable.' Ye Qing revealed a mysterious smile. 'I've prepared a spatial teleportation formation that can directly leave the Holy Sect's territory. But it can only be used once, so we must move quickly.'

text.content:
Chen Ji pondered silently. This plan had many variables, but it was already the best option available. He gazed at Ye Qing—under the moonlight, this Demonic Path saintess's face held a strange beauty.

'Why help me?' He asked the question again, but his tone had changed.

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, moonlight rippling in her eyes.

'Because I also want to destroy the Holy Sect.' Her voice was soft. 'And you are the most capable of achieving this.' She paused. 'Also... I understand the feeling of losing family.'

text.content:
Chen Ji was slightly stunned. From Ye Qing's eyes, he caught a fleeting glimpse of vulnerability—the true emotion hidden beneath the Holy Sect's formidable exterior.

So it turns out she too is someone toyed with by fate.

dialogue.content: 'Good.' Chen Ji nodded, his voice carrying a hint of warmth. 'In three days, we move together. I'll use the Tianji Record beforehand to confirm the chamber's exact situation, minimizing risks to the lowest.'

'Then it's settled.' Ye Qing turned to leave but stopped after several steps. 'Chen Ji, there's something I must warn you about—the secret of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key is far more complex than you imagine.'

text.content:
Chen Ji's brow furrowed. 'What do you mean?'

Ye Qing didn't turn around, her voice drifting back hauntingly: 'The reason Chen Nian was chosen isn't just because of her bloodline. It's because... she seems to have some kind of fateful connection with the Tianji Record.'

These words struck like a heavy hammer, crashing into Chen Ji's heart.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing revealed a shocking piece of information—Chen Nian has some kind of connection with the Tianji Record. What does this mean for Chen Ji?

choices.description: Chen Nian's connection with the Tianji Record? What secrets lie behind this? He must get to the bottom of this.
choices.visible_cost: May touch upon certain forbidden taboos
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial information to prepare for subsequent actions

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing turned her head back. Moonlight illuminated her complex expression. 'The ancient records of the Holy Sect mention that the Heavenly Fate Key is one chosen by the 'Heavenly Secrets Eye'. And the Tianji Record... might just be one of the fragments of the 'Heavenly Secrets Eye'."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart trembled. The Heavenly Secrets Eye - that was a legendary existence surpassing everything. If Chen Nian truly had a connection to it, her fate was likely far more treacherous than he had imagined.

choices.description: "Regardless of the truth, rescuing my sister is the top priority. Other matters can wait until we meet and clarify everything."
choices.visible_reward: "Focus on executing the plan, minimize variables"

dialogue.content: "Very well." Ye Qing nodded. "Some things indeed can only be explained by those directly involved." Her gaze carried profound meaning. "Good luck to us with the action three days from now."

text.content: The night wind lifted her hair, and Ye Qing's silhouette appeared particularly desolate under the moonlight. She suddenly stopped her footsteps and slowly turned around.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." Ye Qing's voice suddenly turned gentle. "This time, whether we succeed or fail, I won't regret knowing you."

text.content:
Moonlight poured like water between the two of them. Chen Ji looked into Ye Qing's eyes, suddenly discovering that the usual coldness within had melted away to a great extent, replaced by a softness he had never witnessed before.

This woman, always as cold as ice, now resembled a girl awaiting an answer.

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing." Chen Ji spoke, his voice low. "After I rescue Chen Nian, I will give you an answer." His gaze was sincere. "Regarding our cooperation, and also... the other matter."

text.content:
A flash of delight appeared in Ye Qing's eyes, soon replaced by her customary composure. She nodded gently. "Alright. I'll wait for you."

Under the moonlight, her figure gradually faded into the distance, yet she turned her head one last time. That glance contained too many emotions Chen Ji could not decipher.

Chen Ji stood alone in the night wind, his heart churning. Twelve years had passed, and finally he glimpsed hope. His sister who had been taken away, the family member he thought he had lost forever, was now deep within the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds, awaiting his rescue.

Three days.

He only needed to wait three more days.

dialogue.content: "Young man." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying a hint of relief. "This old man has waited for this day for a very long time."
"Mo Xiansheng." Chen Ji responded in his heart. "Did you always know about Chen Nian's situation?"

"Heavenly secrets cannot be revealed." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of helplessness. "But this old man can tell you one thing - Chen Nian's existence is crucial to the completeness of the Tianji Record. She is not only your sister, but also... the key to destiny."

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent. The weight of those four words - the key to destiny - he understood better than anyone.

But no matter what identity Chen Nian held, she was first and foremost the sister he wished to protect. This would never change.

"Mo Xiansheng, in three days I will use the Tianji Record to confirm the situation in the secret chamber." His voice was resolute. "Please lend me your strength."

dialogue.content: "Very well." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of approval. "However, this old man must warn you - the Tianji Record's foresight ability will be disrupted near Chen Nian. You will need to expend much more Heavenly Fate to see even a blurred image."

text.content:
Chen Ji nodded. He still had sufficient Heavenly Fate in reserve. For Chen Nian's sake, even if it meant depleting all ten or twenty points, he would not hesitate.

The night wind grew cooler. He turned and walked toward his lodging. In three days, he needed to make every preparation.

In a certain corner of the Holy Sect, a girl suddenly awoke from a nightmare, her eyes filled with fear and confusion - she had dreamed of a person, a relative whose face she could no longer clearly remember.

"Brother..." Her voice was barely a whisper. "Where are you..."

At the same time, Ye Qing had quietly returned to the Holy Sect's outpost. She stood by the window, gazing at the distant horizon, Chen Ji's parting words echoing endlessly in her mind.

"This man..." she murmured, an involuntary smile tugging at the corner of her lips. "He's actually somewhat... intriguing."

In three days, the storm would arrive. And she had made every preparation - including the teleportation talisman long hidden in her sleeve, and that unexpected emotion in her heart.

As they parted, the night wind suddenly rose.

Ye Qing stopped her steps and turned around. Moonlight fell upon her, outlining her silhouette like a painting. She walked slowly toward Chen Ji, and before he could react, she stood on tiptoe and pressed a passionate kiss to his lips.

"This is a deposit." Her voice was tender. "See you in three days."
